title: CloudSecurity
description: CloudSecurity is a Reporting and HelpOps system for velocity proxies.
body:
**CloudSecurity** is a reporting and help system for Velocity proxies.

**Modules**

The plugin is divided into several modules that can be enabled or disabled depending on the network's needs.

**Commands**

This module offers versatility by allowing you to edit the necessary permissions for commands and aliases, as well as whether they are enabled or disabled.

**MySQL**

The plugin uses MySQL as its database. You can also configure it to disable or enable the database.

**Configuration and Flexibility**

One of CloudSecurity’s strengths is its customization capabilities:

**Modularity**: All modules (except the main one) can be enabled or disabled individually.

**Full Configuration**: Virtually 100% of the plugin is configurable. This includes all messages displayed to players and the vast majority of behavior options for each module.

**Command List**

• /report <player> <reason> - reports a player for disciplinary action.

• /helpop <message> - sends a help request to staff.

• /reports - hides report messages.

• /helpops - hides helpop messages.

• /cloudsecurity reload - reloads all settings.
